title: Expose canonical backend observation for first-attempt coupled-window rejection
purpose: After RESP01A/B isolated the acceptance pattern and first-attempt rejection category, read the backend's already-public immutable observation immediately after a single no-retry trial. Determine whether the first rejection is accompanied by a finite temporal head bound/budget/certificate or solver status/equation-residual/iteration diagnostics.

scope.trial_heads: Actual MODFLOW trial heads frozen in F-GC-STRIP01_C0_C1_QUALIFICATION_AND_RESPONSE_FINDINGS.md

primary: existing result status and rejection counters
solver equation residual availability/value and solver diagnostic route/iterations
temporal head infinity bound, supplied/valid head budget, normalized indicator
temporal certificate availability and unavailable reason
additional tridiagonal and full nonlinear solve counts
measurement.state_integrity: Capture committed state before and after every trial; require exact equality. Require no candidate commit. Reinitialize a fresh process and require exact parsed-JSON equality.
measurement.implementation_boundary: Only a research fixture copy and local diagnostic harness may change. No production source, ABI, acceptance gate, or tolerance change.

interpretation_limits: This diagnostic explains first-attempt observations only; it does not change rejection behavior or qualify an accepted interval.
A finite public observation field is not by itself proof of the internal causal root unless its gate and status agree.
No accepted coupled window, Hupsel run, or coupled qualification is claimed.

reproducibility.source_ref: integration/f-ci-canonical at the recorded canonical reconcile head
